t: The many-pinned chip inside the Arduino Mega and classic 3D printer boards.
steps: Buy an Arduino Mega 2560 or a compatible board from the Arduino store or a maker shop.
Get a USB cable that fits the board. The official Mega uses a square USB-B plug.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Some clone boards use a CH340 USB chip. Install its driver on older computers.
Plug in the board and choose Arduino Mega 2560 from the board menu.
Open the Blink example and press Upload. The small light on the board starts to blink.
Add a button and an LED on a breadboard to try your first circuit.
meta: Wild Open. From $19.99. A few stores.
